display_name: 投影修正第11轮源域批次级技术复现
description: 从原 E10 技术状态按原训练轨迹临时重放 E11，遇投影修正 NMSE 大于 100 时定位源批次并测量提案和投影算子。

data.version: Original R07 draw11 63000 source rows, L_s6300/U_s56700, original saved E11 order.
data.representation: Original source clean/received IQ, simulator Action/noise and frozen original F0 continuous features.
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; original simulated source physical action/noise and frozen original F0 continuous features.
data.augmentation: Original saved draw11 and epoch11 permutation, no new source synthesis.

permissions.query_use: Original L_s/U_s source rows only; no TX truth, V/OE/target inputs or target predictions.
permissions.claim_scope: Technical replay to localize finite source update spike. No saved G candidate or target accuracy; shared-GPU numerical trajectory may diverge.

checkpoint.initialization: Original source-only ProjectedPriorDetail E10/2470 model, AdamW and RNG loaded only for disposable E11 replay; no candidate is saved.
sources: Original frozen source Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 and original source mean/covariance.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original E10 code/config/epoch/steps and technical-only metadata, source-only smoke and saved E11 order/draw; exact original source release imported.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original E10 source L_s/U_s only, F0 continuous guidance, no TX/V/OE/target. Temporary optimizer steps cannot initialize deployment.
checkpoint.selection_rule: E10 fixed as epoch boundary before observed spike, not model selection; stop at first projected update NMSE>100 or original numerical guard, otherwise stop after E11.

metric_names: Per-record projected update NMSE>100, source scene, original output/error and preceding temporary update count.

At spike, recorded raw prior proposal and projected correction norms, detail gradient norm, predicted noise, original residual and Euclidean spectral norm of actual projected operator. P@proposal is checked against actual correction.
All values are source training diagnostics; no deployment model, target accuracy, identity inference or general information upper bound.

rows.purpose: Locate the first large source projected correction and distinguish proposal and operator amplification.
rows.seed_notes: Original E10 saved RNG, E11 order and draw11.
rows.scenario: Original L_s/U_s source only, no target.
rows.optimizer: Original AdamW state temporarily restored; original LR/branch clipping unchanged.

notes: Original E11 mean projected update NMSE was1843.75 with large preclip gradient, while original E10 and E12/E13 were near0.001–0.003. All saved states finite.
Fixed E10/E11 source stress test on149 deliberately extreme rows did not reproduce the spike. A full bounded trajectory may expose the responsible intermediate state or unsampled row.
Source flags and loss threshold fixed before execution; do not relax the original posterior guard. Replaying on another shared GPU can produce a different trajectory.
Three focused tests and one independent P0/P1 review PASS; actual E10/F0 source2 no-query smoke precedes replay.
No original experiment model, data, schedule, budget, other owner or default DURA is modified.
